snippet.title: BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: Halloween Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY is a first-person psychological horror game following Hideo, a young hikikomori obsessed with video games and the need for recognition.

After receiving a mysterious experimental console, Hideo begins playing a game that slowly breaks the boundary between the virtual world and reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences in the real world.

The story expands the BrokenLore universe and is closely connected to the events of DON'T WATCH and DON'T LIE.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
